g.title: registry
g.text: Units, dates, rights and completeness contract

g.title: ingest
g.text: Bounded requests, pagination, retries, schema checks
Content hashes, explicit failures and durable job state

g.title: raw
g.text: Original JSON / CSV / XLSX / document bytes
Query scope, retrieval time and source dates

g.title: validate
g.text: Unknown and failed checks remain explicit

g.title: assessment
g.text: Assessment date + engine/rule versions + input hash

g.title: note
g.text: Action priorities are workflow policy, not loss probabilities.
A completed download is not complete due diligence.
A new input or rule version creates a new assessment.
